name: security
description: API baseline: secure headers, CORS allowlist of exact origins (no wildcard with credentials), body size limit, basic per-client rate limit

env.description: Exact origins allowed to call the API from a browser, comma-separated (no wildcard). Empty = same-origin only

Requests per window per client; 0 = no rate limit in the app. Per client = per TCP peer, or per user behind the trusted reverse proxy (AUTH_PROXY_SECRET / AUTH_TRUSTED_PROXIES) — behind an untrusted proxy everyone shares one budget
Largest request body accepted (413 above it)
